Name: Lovely Grass CP
Author: RaffieJohn
Description:
It is such lovely grass to walk on.

The grass has nine different colors to choose from:

Blue, Cream, Light Blue, Light Green, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, Yellow.

For Spring its default is Pink.
For Summer its default is Yellow.
For Fall its default is Orange.
For Winter its default is Light Blue.


Compatibility:
Works well with Daisy Niko's Recolor mod!
